questions.question: What did Isaiah see in his vision in chapter 6?
options: A wide valley filled with very dry and scattered dead bones
The Lord sitting on a throne, high and lifted up, with seraphim
A great and towering statue of gold and of silver and of bronze and clay
A long scroll written all over on both the front and the back
questions.answer: The Lord sitting on a throne, high and lifted up, with seraphim

questions.question: What did the seraphim call out?
options: 'Glory to God in the highest heaven'
'Worthy is the Lamb who was slain'
'Holy, holy, holy is the LORD of hosts'
questions.answer: 'Holy, holy, holy is the LORD of hosts'

questions.question: Isaiah responded to God's call by saying, 'Here I am! Send me.'
Woe is me! For I am lost; for I am a man of unclean _____.
Whom shall I send, and who will go for us? Then I said, 'Here am I! _____ me.'
